```{r}
library (Seurat)
library (plotly)
library (ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
RBC <- readRDS("/mnt/icbs_shared_storage_general_2022/sanger22/scRNAseq_Cordblood/Cordblood_MS2022/hemoglobin_containing_dataset.rds")
```

```{r}
#move soft cutoff to metadata
RBC$softCO <- Idents(RBC)
```

```{r}
#classify cell stages based on globin expression

#early
early_HBB_high_Seu <- WhichCells(object = RBC, expression = HBA1 > 3 & HBA1 < 3.5 & HBB > 5 & HBG2 < 4)
early_HBG_high_Seu <- WhichCells(object = RBC, expression = HBA1 > 3 & HBA1 < 3.5 & HBB < 5 & HBG2 > 6)

#intermediate
int_HBB_high_Seu <- WhichCells(object = RBC, expression = HBA1 > 4 & HBA1 < 4.5 & HBB > 3.5 & HBG2 <4)
int_HBG_high_Seu <- WhichCells(object = RBC, expression = HBA1 > 4 & HBA1 < 4.5 & HBB < 3.5 & HBG2 >6)

#late
late_HBB_high_Seu <- WhichCells(object = RBC, expression = HBA1 > 6.25 & HBA1 < 6.75 & HBB > 5.5 & HBG2 <4.5)
late_HBG_high_Seu <- WhichCells(object = RBC, expression = HBA1 > 6.25 & HBA1 < 6.75 & HBB < 5.5 & HBG2 >7)
```

```{r}
#Rename clusters
#early
Idents(object = RBC, cells = early_HBB_high_Seu) <- "early_high_HBB"
Idents(object = RBC, cells = early_HBG_high_Seu) <- "early_high_HBG"

#intermediate
Idents(object = RBC, cells = int_HBB_high_Seu) <- "int_high_HBB"
Idents(object = RBC, cells = int_HBG_high_Seu) <- "int_high_HBG"
#late
Idents(object = RBC, cells = late_HBB_high_Seu) <- "late_high_HBB"
Idents(object = RBC, cells = late_HBG_high_Seu) <- "late_high_HBG"
```

```{r}
#Keep idents in HardCO slot
RBC@meta.data$hardCO <- Idents(RBC)
```

```{r}
#Create stage and HB metadata
early <- WhichCells(object = RBC,idents = c("early_high_HBB", "early_high_HBG"))
int <- WhichCells(object = RBC,idents = c("int_high_HBB", "int_high_HBG"))
late <- WhichCells(object = RBC,idents = c("late_high_HBB", "late_high_HBG"))

Idents(RBC, cells = early) <- "early"
Idents(RBC, cells = int) <- "int"
Idents(RBC, cells = late) <- "late"
RBC@meta.data$stage <- Idents(RBC)

#Swich back to Hard CO
Idents(RBC) <- RBC@meta.data$hardCO
HBB_High <- WhichCells(object = RBC,idents = c("early_high_HBB", "int_high_HBB", "late_high_HBB"))
HBG_High <- WhichCells(object = RBC,idents = c("early_high_HBG", "int_high_HBG", "late_high_HBG"))
Idents(RBC, cells = HBB_High) <- "HBB_High"
Idents(RBC, cells = HBG_High) <- "HBG_High"

RBC@meta.data$HB <- Idents(RBC)

#Swich back to Hard CO
Idents(RBC) <- RBC@meta.data$hardCO
```

```{r}
Idents(RBC) <- "HB"
table(RBC@active.ident)
RBC <- RenameIdents(RBC,
                    'HBG_High' = 'HBG_high',
                    'HBB_High' = 'HBB_high')
levels(RBC)
RBC@meta.data$HB <- Idents(RBC)
```

```{r}
table(RBC@meta.data$stage)
table(RBC@meta.data$hardCO)
table(RBC@meta.data$HB)
```
```{r}
RBC@meta.data$stage <- factor(RBC@meta.data$stage,
                         levels = c("early", "int", "late",       
                                    "early_HBG", "early_HBB", "late_HBG", "late_HBB"))

RBC@meta.data$hardCO <- factor(RBC@meta.data$hardCO,
                         levels = c("early_high_HBG", "early_high_HBB", 
                                    "int_high_HBG", "int_high_HBB",
                                    "late_high_HBG", "late_high_HBB",
                                    "early_HBG", "late_HBG", "early_HBB", "late_HBB"))
```

```{r}
Idents(RBC) <- "hardCO"
#Plot violin plot for transcription factor of interest
plot1 <- VlnPlot(object = RBC, idents = c("early_high_HBB", "early_high_HBG", "int_high_HBB", "int_high_HBG", "late_high_HBB", "late_high_HBG"), features = c("MTF2","NME2", "YBX3", "ETS2","DNMT1"), pt = 0.1, group.by = "stage", split.by = "HB", slot = "data")
```
```{r}
p_legend <- VlnPlot(object = RBC, idents = c("early_high_HBB", "early_high_HBG", "int_high_HBB", "int_high_HBG", "late_high_HBB", "late_high_HBG"), features = c("MTF2"), pt = 0.5, group.by = "stage", split.by = "HB", slot = "data")
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2) 
library(grid)
library(gridExtra) 
library(cowplot)
# Using the cowplot package
legend <- cowplot::get_legend(p_legend)

grid.newpage()
grid.draw(legend)
```
```{r}
plot_grid(plot1, legend, ncol = 2, rel_widths = c(0.8,0.2))
```

```{r}
saveRDS(RBC, file = "/mnt/icbs_shared_storage_general_2022/sanger22/scRNAseq_Cordblood/Cordblood_MS2022/hemoglobin_containing_dataset_hardCO.rds")
```

```{r}
Intermediate <- subset(x = RBC, idents = c("int_high_HBB", "int_high_HBG"), invert = TRUE)
Idents(Intermediate) <- "HB"
Intermediate_plot <- VlnPlot(Intermediate, features = c("SLC4A1", "HBA1", "HBB", "HBG2"), idents = c("HBG_high", "HBB_high"), split.by = "HB", ncol = 4)

Late <- subset(x = RBC, idents = c("late_high_HBB", "late_high_HBG"), invert = TRUE)
Idents(Late) <- "HB"
Late_plot <- VlnPlot(Late, features = c("SLC4A1", "HBA1", "HBB", "HBG2"), idents = c("HBG_high", "HBB_high"), split.by = "HB", ncol = 4)
```

```{r}
DefaultAssay(RBC) <- "RNA"
Idents(RBC) <- "hardCO"
table(RBC@meta.data$hardCO)
```

```{r}
#Find DEG by early_high_HBB compare to early_high_HBG
earlyHBBHBGhigh.markers <- FindMarkers(RBC, ident.1 = "early_high_HBB", ident.2 = "early_high_HBG", logfc.threshold = 0, base = 2, min.pct = 0.25)
head(earlyHBBHBGhigh.markers, n = 10)

#Convert avg_log2FC to avg_logFC
earlyHBBHBGhigh.markers$avg_value <- 2^(earlyHBBHBGhigh.markers$avg_log2FC)
earlyHBBHBGhigh.markers$avg_logFC <- log(earlyHBBHBGhigh.markers$avg_value, base = exp(1))

#Save table
write.csv(earlyHBBHBGhigh.markers, "/mnt/icbs_shared_storage_general_2022/sanger22/scRNAseq_Cordblood/Cordblood_MS2022/Tables/Hard_Cutoff/2023_earlyHBBHBGhigh_hardCO_minpct0.25.markers.csv")
```
```{r}
#20% Difference
log1.2 <- log(1.2, base = exp(1))
earlyHBBHBGhigh.markers_20 <- earlyHBBHBGhigh.markers %>% filter(p_val_adj<0.05) %>% arrange(avg_logFC) %>% filter(avg_logFC>log1.2)
write.csv(earlyHBBHBGhigh.markers_20, "/mnt/icbs_shared_storage_general_2022/sanger22/scRNAseq_Cordblood/Cordblood_MS2022/Tables/Hard_Cutoff/2023_earlyHBBHBGhigh_hardCO_20diff_minpct0.25.markers.csv")

#50% Difference
log1.5 <- log(1.5, base = exp(1))
earlyHBBHBGhigh.markers_50 <- earlyHBBHBGhigh.markers %>% filter(p_val_adj<0.05) %>% arrange(avg_logFC) %>% filter(avg_logFC>log1.5)
write.csv(earlyHBBHBGhigh.markers_50, "/mnt/icbs_shared_storage_general_2022/sanger22/scRNAseq_Cordblood/Cordblood_MS2022/Tables/Hard_Cutoff/2023_earlyHBBHBGhigh_hardCO_50diff_minpct0.25.markers.csv")
```
